school.tagged_body:
Grade 5 {{v:Field Trip}} to the City Science {{v:Museum}}

Dear parents and students,

{{t:Our Grade 5 students will go to the City Science Museum.}} They {{g:will see|will + 동사원형: ~할 것이다 (미래)}} {{v:robots}} and dinosaur {{v:bones}}. They will also watch a space show.

Date: Thursday, November 6
Time: 8:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
{{v:Meeting place}}: School {{v:playground}} (The bus {{g:leaves|정해진 일정은 현재시제로 쓴다: 버스가 떠난다}} at 8:40 a.m.)
{{v:Cost}}: 12,000 won (bus and ticket)
What to bring: lunch box, water bottle, notebook, pencil

Please note:
- {{g:Wear|명령문: 동사원형으로 시작한다 (~해라)}} {{v:comfortable}} shoes.
- {{g:Don't bring|부정 명령문: Don't + 동사원형 (~하지 마라)}} toys or games.
- Stay with your {{v:group}} all the time.

Please bring back the {{v:permission form}} {{g:by Friday, October 31|by + 날짜: ~까지 (기한)}}.

questions.q: What is this notice about?
choices: A field trip to a science museum
questions.answer: A field trip to a science museum
questions.explanation: 제목과 첫 문장 'Our Grade 5 students will go to the City Science Museum.'에서 과학관 현장 학습 안내문임을 알 수 있다.

questions.q: Who will go to the museum?
questions.explanation: 'Our Grade 5 students will go to the City Science Museum.'과 일치한다.

questions.q: What will the students NOT see at the museum?
questions.explanation: 로봇, 공룡 뼈, 우주 쇼는 나오지만 유명한 그림(paintings)은 나오지 않는다.

questions.q: When is the field trip?
questions.explanation: 'Date: Thursday, November 6'에서 확인할 수 있다. 10월 31일 금요일은 동의서를 내는 날이다.

questions.q: What time does the trip start?
questions.explanation: 'Time: 8:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.'이므로 오전 8시 30분에 시작한다. 8시 40분은 버스가 떠나는 시각이다.

questions.q: What time does the bus leave?
questions.explanation: 'The bus leaves at 8:40 a.m.'과 일치한다.

questions.q: Where do the students meet?
questions.explanation: 'Meeting place: School playground'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: How much does the trip cost?
questions.explanation: 'Cost: 12,000 won'과 일치한다.

questions.q: What does the 12,000 won pay for?
questions.explanation: '12,000 won (bus and ticket)'이므로 버스비와 입장권 값이다.

questions.q: What is NOT on the "What to bring" list?
questions.explanation: 준비물은 도시락, 물병, 공책, 연필이다. 카메라는 없다.

questions.q: What kind of shoes should the students wear?
questions.explanation: 'Wear comfortable shoes.'와 일치한다.

questions.q: What should the students NOT bring?
questions.explanation: 'Don't bring toys or games.'에서 장난감과 게임은 가져오면 안 된다.

questions.q: 다음 중 'permission form'의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: permission은 '허락', form은 '서류'라는 뜻이다. 현장 학습에 보내도 된다고 허락하는 동의서이다.

questions.q: 다음 중 'comfortable'의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: comfortable은 '편안한'이라는 뜻이다. 'Wear comfortable shoes.'는 편한 신발을 신으라는 말이다.

questions.q: By when should the permission form come back?
questions.explanation: 'Please bring back the permission form by Friday, October 31.'과 일치한다.

questions.q: Which is true about the trip?
choices: The students meet at the museum.
questions.explanation: '8:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.'이므로 오후 3시에 끝난다. 여행은 목요일, 버스는 8시 40분, 모이는 곳은 학교 운동장, 게임은 가져올 수 없다.

questions.q: Who follows the rules best?
choices: Sora walks around the museum alone.
Tom comes to the playground at 8:50 a.m.
Yuna brings a game for the bus.
Jimin wears comfortable shoes and stays with her group.
questions.answer: Jimin wears comfortable shoes and stays with her group.
questions.explanation: 지민이만 규칙(편한 신발, 모둠과 함께 있기)을 지켰다. 장난감·게임은 금지, 혼자 다니면 안 되고, 8시 50분에 오면 8시 40분 버스를 놓친다.

questions.q: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? "____ comfortable shoes."
questions.explanation: 명령문은 주어 없이 동사원형으로 시작한다. 그래서 Wear가 알맞다.

items: The bus leaves for the museum.
Parents give back the permission form.
Students meet at the school playground.
answer: Parents give back the permission form.
Students meet at the school playground.
The bus leaves for the museum.

essays.q: Where will the Grade 5 students go? Write in English.
essays.sampleAnswer: They will go to the City Science Museum.
essays.rubric: 시티 과학관(City Science Museum)에 간다는 내용을 완전한 문장으로 쓰면 만점

essays.q: What should the students bring? Write two things in English.
essays.sampleAnswer: They should bring a lunch box and a water bottle.
essays.rubric: 준비물(도시락, 물병, 공책, 연필) 중 두 가지를 영어로 맞게 쓰면 만점, 한 가지면 부분 점수

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 현장 학습 날 학생들이 지켜야 할 것 세 가지를 쓰시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: ① 편한 신발을 신는다. ② 장난감이나 게임을 가져오지 않는다. ③ 항상 모둠과 함께 있는다.
essays.rubric: 세 가지를 모두 쓰면 만점, 두 가지면 부분 점수

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 언제까지 무엇을 내야 하나요?
essays.sampleAnswer: 10월 31일 금요일까지 동의서(허락서)를 내야 한다.
essays.rubric: ① 10월 31일(금요일) ② 동의서 두 가지가 모두 들어가면 만점

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오. '장난감을 가져오지 마세요.' <조건> Don't를 사용할 것
essays.sampleAnswer: Don't bring toys.
essays.rubric: ① Don't + 동사원형(bring) ② toys 사용 ③ 의미 일치 (Do not bring toys.도 정답)

academy.tagged_body:
Grade 5 {{v:Field Trip}} to the City Science {{v:Museum}}

Dear parents and students,

{{t:Our Grade 5 students will visit the City Science Museum.}} They {{g:will see|will + 동사원형: ~할 것이다 (미래)}} {{v:robots}}, dinosaur {{v:bones}}, and a space show.

Date: Thursday, November 6
Time: 8:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
Meeting place: School {{v:playground}} (The bus {{g:leaves|정해진 일정은 현재시제로 쓴다: 버스가 떠난다}} at 8:40 a.m.)
{{v:Cost}}: 12,000 won (bus and ticket)
What to bring: lunch box, water bottle, notebook, pencil

Please note:
- {{g:Wear|명령문: 동사원형으로 시작한다 (~해라)}} {{v:comfortable}} shoes.
- {{g:Do not bring|부정 명령문: Do not(Don't) + 동사원형 (~하지 마라)}} toys or games.
- Stay with your group {{v:at all times}}.

Please {{v:return}} the {{v:permission form}} {{g:by Friday, October 31|by + 날짜: ~까지 (기한)}}.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this notice?
choices: To give information about a field trip
To invite parents to a science class
To change the date of a trip
To ask for money for new robots
questions.answer: To give information about a field trip
questions.explanation: 현장 학습의 날짜, 시간, 장소, 비용, 준비물, 주의사항을 알려 주는 안내문이다.

questions.q: Who is this notice written for?
questions.explanation: 'Dear parents and students,'로 시작하므로 학부모와 학생에게 쓴 글이다.

questions.q: Which will the students see at the museum?
questions.explanation: 'They will see robots, dinosaur bones, and a space show.'에 우주 쇼가 나온다. 살아 있는 공룡이 아니라 공룡 뼈이다.

questions.q: How long is the field trip?
choices: About six and a half hours
questions.answer: About six and a half hours
questions.explanation: 오전 8시 30분부터 오후 3시까지이므로 6시간 30분이다.

questions.q: How many minutes are there between the meeting time and the bus time?
questions.explanation: 8시 30분에 모이고 버스는 8시 40분에 떠나므로 10분 차이다.

questions.q: What will probably happen if a student arrives at the playground at 8:45 a.m.?
choices: The student will get a free ticket.
The bus will wait for an hour.
The trip will start at 9:00 a.m.
The student may miss the bus.
The student will see the space show first.
questions.answer: The student may miss the bus.
questions.explanation: 버스가 8시 40분에 떠나므로 8시 45분에 오면 버스를 놓칠 수 있다.

questions.q: What is included in the cost?
questions.explanation: 'Cost: 12,000 won (bus and ticket)'에서 버스비와 입장권이 포함됨을 알 수 있다.

questions.q: Which is NOT something the students need to bring?
questions.explanation: 준비물은 도시락, 물병, 공책, 연필이다. 간식비는 안내문에 없다.

questions.q: Which rule is NOT in the notice?
choices: Do not bring toys or games.
Stay with your group at all times.
questions.explanation: 사진 촬영 금지는 안내문에 없다.

questions.q: 'at all times'의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: at all times는 '항상, 언제나'라는 뜻이다. 'Stay with your group at all times.'는 항상 모둠과 함께 있으라는 말이다.

questions.q: Which word means "saying yes to let someone do something"?
questions.explanation: permission은 '허락'이라는 뜻이다. 'permission form'은 허락(동의)서이다.

questions.q: Which is NOT true according to the notice?
choices: The trip is on Thursday, November 6.
The students meet at the school playground.
The bus leaves the school at 8:30 a.m.
questions.answer: The bus leaves the school at 8:30 a.m.
questions.explanation: 버스는 8시 40분에 떠난다. 8시 30분은 모이는 시각(여행 시작 시각)이다.

questions.q: Who is doing the right thing?
choices: Junho goes straight to the museum by himself.
Mina comes to the playground at 8:30 a.m. with her lunch box.
Hana brings a board game for her friends.
Leo returns the form on November 3.
Sumi leaves her group to see the robots alone.
questions.answer: Mina comes to the playground at 8:30 a.m. with her lunch box.
questions.explanation: 미나만 안내문대로 했다. 혼자 박물관에 가기·게임 가져오기·11월 3일에 동의서 내기·모둠을 떠나기는 모두 안내와 다르다.

questions.q: What should the families do by October 31?
questions.explanation: 'Please return the permission form by Friday, October 31.'과 일치한다.

questions.q: How many days after the form deadline is the field trip?
questions.explanation: 동의서 마감은 10월 31일(금), 현장 학습은 11월 6일(목)이므로 6일 뒤이다.

questions.q: Which sentence is grammatically INCORRECT?
questions.explanation: 명령문은 동사원형으로 시작해야 하므로 Stays가 아니라 Stay가 맞다.

questions.q: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? "The students will ____ a space show."
questions.explanation: will 뒤에는 동사원형이 온다. 그래서 see가 알맞다.

questions.q: In 'The bus leaves at 8:40 a.m.', which word is the opposite of 'leaves'?
questions.explanation: leave(떠나다)의 반대말은 arrive(도착하다)이다.

items: The bus leaves the school at 8:40 a.m.
Students see robots, dinosaur bones, and a space show.
Students meet at the school playground at 8:30 a.m.
answer: Students meet at the school playground at 8:30 a.m.
The bus leaves the school at 8:40 a.m.
Students see robots, dinosaur bones, and a space show.

essays.q: What will the students see at the museum? Write three things in English.
essays.sampleAnswer: They will see robots, dinosaur bones, and a space show.
essays.rubric: ① 로봇 ② 공룡 뼈 ③ 우주 쇼 세 가지를 모두 쓰면 만점, 두 가지면 부분 점수

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 버스는 8시 40분에 출발하는데, 학생들은 몇 시까지 어디에 모여야 하나요? 그렇게 하는 이유도 쓰시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: 오전 8시 30분까지 학교 운동장에 모여야 한다. 버스가 8시 40분에 떠나므로 늦지 않게 미리 모여야 하기 때문이다.
essays.rubric: ① 8시 30분 ② 학교 운동장 ③ 버스를 놓치지 않기 위해(버스가 8시 40분에 떠나서) 모두 쓰면 만점

essays.q: Imagine you are a student going on this trip. What will you bring? Start with "I will bring".
essays.sampleAnswer: I will bring a lunch box, a water bottle, a notebook, and a pencil.
essays.rubric: ① 'I will bring'으로 시작 ② 본문 준비물 2개 이상 ③ 장난감·게임을 쓰면 감점

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오. '항상 너의 모둠과 함께 있어라.' <조건> stay와 at all times를 사용할 것
essays.sampleAnswer: Stay with your group at all times.
essays.rubric: ① 명령문(동사원형 Stay로 시작) ② with your group ③ at all times 모두 맞으면 만점

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 학생이 현장 학습 날 지켜야 할 규칙 세 가지와, 그 전에 가족이 해야 할 일 한 가지를 쓰시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: 규칙: ① 편한 신발을 신는다. ② 장난감이나 게임을 가져오지 않는다. ③ 항상 모둠과 함께 있는다. 가족이 할 일: 10월 31일 금요일까지 동의서를 낸다.
essays.rubric: 규칙 3가지 + 할 일 1가지(동의서 제출, 날짜 포함)를 모두 쓰면 만점, 일부만 쓰면 부분 점수

advanced.tagged_body:
Grade 5 {{v:Field Trip}} to the City Science Museum

Dear parents and students,

We are delighted to {{v:announce}} that {{t:our Grade 5 students will be visiting the City Science Museum next month.}} During their visit, they will have {{g:a chance to see|to부정사의 형용사적 용법: 앞의 명사 chance를 꾸밈 (볼 기회)}} moving robots and actual dinosaur bones, and they will also experience an exciting space show.

Date: Thursday, November 6
Time: 8:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
Meeting place: School playground (The bus {{v:departs}} at 8:40 a.m., so please don't be late.)
Cost: 12,000 won ({{v:including}} the bus and the museum ticket)
What to bring: a lunch box, a water bottle, a notebook, and a pencil

Please note:
- Students {{g:should wear|should + 동사원형: ~해야 한다 (충고)}} {{v:comfortable}} shoes {{g:because they will walk a lot|because + 주어 + 동사: ~하기 때문에 (이유)}}.
- Students should not bring any toys or games.
- Students {{g:must stay|must + 동사원형: 반드시 ~해야 한다 (의무)}} with their group at all times.

Please {{g:make sure to return|make sure to + 동사원형: 반드시 ~하도록 하다}} the {{v:signed}} {{v:permission form}} by Friday, October 31.

grammar: to부정사 형용사적 용법 (a chance to see)

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this notice?
choices: To introduce the history of the museum
To tell students how robots are made
To announce that the trip is canceled
To give details about a trip and ask for a signed form
To ask parents to drive students to the museum
questions.answer: To give details about a trip and ask for a signed form
questions.explanation: 현장 학습의 세부 사항을 알리고, 서명한 동의서를 내 달라고 요청하는 글이다.

questions.q: In which month was this notice most likely written?
questions.explanation: 현장 학습(11월 6일)이 'next month'이고 동의서 마감이 10월 31일이므로 10월에 쓴 글이다.

questions.q: Why should the students wear comfortable shoes?
choices: Because the museum gives a prize
Because they will walk a lot
questions.answer: Because they will walk a lot
questions.explanation: 'Students should wear comfortable shoes because they will walk a lot.'에서 이유를 알 수 있다.

questions.q: Why does the notice say "please don't be late"?
choices: Because the bus departs at 8:40 a.m.
Because the museum opens at 8:30 a.m.
Because the space show is first
Because the form is due that day
questions.answer: Because the bus departs at 8:40 a.m.
questions.explanation: 'The bus departs at 8:40 a.m., so please don't be late.' — 버스가 8시 40분에 떠나기 때문이다.

questions.q: What does the 12,000 won include?
choices: The bus and the museum ticket
questions.answer: The bus and the museum ticket
questions.explanation: '12,000 won (including the bus and the museum ticket)'과 일치한다.

questions.q: How long will the students be on the trip?
questions.explanation: 오전 8시 30분부터 오후 3시까지이므로 6시간 30분이다.

questions.q: What kind of robots will the students see?
questions.explanation: 'they will have a chance to see moving robots'와 일치한다.

questions.q: Which is NOT true according to the notice?
choices: The trip is on Thursday, November 6.
Students may bring one small toy.
The bus departs from the school at 8:40 a.m.
Students will see real dinosaur bones.
questions.answer: Students may bring one small toy.
questions.explanation: 'Students should not bring any toys or games.'이므로 작은 장난감도 가져올 수 없다.

questions.q: Who does NOT follow the notice?
choices: Kevin wears his most comfortable sneakers.
Sujin arrives at the playground at 8:25 a.m.
Eric stays with his group all day.
Dana brings a small game player in her bag.
Ara packs a lunch box and a water bottle.
questions.answer: Dana brings a small game player in her bag.
questions.explanation: 'should not bring any toys or games'라고 했으므로 게임기를 가져온 Dana가 안내를 지키지 않았다.

questions.q: What must families return by October 31?
questions.explanation: 'Please make sure to return the signed permission form by Friday, October 31.'과 일치한다.

questions.q: 'signed'의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: signed는 '서명한, 사인한'이라는 뜻이다. 부모님이 사인한 동의서를 내라는 말이다.

questions.q: Which word is closest in meaning to 'departs'?
questions.explanation: depart는 '출발하다, 떠나다'로 leave와 뜻이 가깝다.

questions.q: 'announce'의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: announce는 '알리다, 발표하다'라는 뜻이다.

questions.q: Which sentence is grammatically INCORRECT?
choices: They will have a chance to see robots.
Make sure to return the form.
They will be visiting the museum.
Students must stays with their group.
questions.answer: Students must stays with their group.
questions.explanation: must 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 하므로 stays가 아니라 stay가 맞다.

questions.q: Which 'to' is used in the same way as in 'a chance to see moving robots'?
choices: I want to see the robots.
I have some homework to do.
She went to the museum to see robots.
To see real bones is exciting.
He was happy to see the space show.
questions.answer: I have some homework to do.
questions.explanation: 'a chance to see'의 to부정사는 앞의 명사 chance를 꾸민다. 'homework to do'도 명사 homework를 꾸미는 형용사적 용법이다.

questions.q: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? "Students should wear comfortable shoes ____ they will walk a lot."
questions.explanation: 뒤 내용(많이 걸을 것이다)이 이유이므로 because가 알맞다.

questions.q: Which information is NOT given in the notice?
choices: What time the students will arrive at the museum
questions.answer: What time the students will arrive at the museum
questions.explanation: 박물관에 도착하는 시각은 나와 있지 않다.

questions.q: Which best completes the sentence? "The notice tells students to (A) ____ comfortable shoes and to (B) ____ their toys at home."
questions.explanation: 편한 신발을 신고(wear), 장난감은 집에 두고 오라(leave)는 뜻이다. 'should not bring any toys'와 같은 의미이다.

items: The bus departs, so nobody should be late.
Families return the signed permission form.
Students enjoy moving robots, dinosaur bones, and a space show.
Students gather at the school playground.
answer: Families return the signed permission form.
Students gather at the school playground.
The bus departs, so nobody should be late.
Students enjoy moving robots, dinosaur bones, and a space show.

essays.q: Why should the students wear comfortable shoes? Answer in a complete English sentence.
essays.sampleAnswer: They should wear comfortable shoes because they will walk a lot.
essays.rubric: ① because를 사용한 이유 ② 많이 걷는다는 내용 ③ 완전한 영어 문장

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 버스 시각과 관련해 학생들이 주의해야 할 점과 그 이유를 쓰시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: 버스가 오전 8시 40분에 출발하므로 늦지 않도록 8시 30분까지 학교 운동장에 와야 한다.
essays.rubric: ① 늦지 말 것(8시 30분까지 운동장) ② 버스가 8시 40분에 출발한다는 이유 모두 쓰면 만점

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오. '우리는 많이 걸을 것이기 때문에 편한 신발을 신어야 한다.' <조건> should와 because를 사용할 것
essays.sampleAnswer: We should wear comfortable shoes because we will walk a lot.
essays.rubric: ① should + 동사원형(wear) ② because + 주어 + 동사 ③ 의미 일치

essays.q: Write two things the students must do on the day of the trip. Use two complete English sentences.
essays.sampleAnswer: They must come to the school playground by 8:30 a.m. They must stay with their group at all times.
essays.rubric: ① 본문 내용에 맞는 할 일 2가지 ② 완전한 영어 문장 2개 ③ 문법 오류 없음

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 12,000원에 포함된 것은 무엇이고, 학생이 직접 챙겨야 하는 것은 무엇인지 쓰시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: 12,000원에는 버스비와 박물관 입장권이 포함된다. 학생은 도시락, 물병, 공책, 연필을 직접 챙겨야 한다.
essays.rubric: ① 포함된 것(버스, 입장권) ② 챙길 것(도시락, 물병, 공책, 연필 중 3개 이상) 모두 쓰면 만점

prestudy.tagged_body:
Grade 5 Field Trip to the City Science Museum

Dear parents and students,

We {{g:are pleased to inform|be pleased to + 동사원형: ~하게 되어 기쁘다 (감정의 원인)}} you that {{t:our Grade 5 students will be taking an educational field trip to the City Science Museum.}} Throughout the visit, students will have the {{v:opportunity}} to {{v:observe}} robots in action, {{v:examine}} {{v:genuine}} dinosaur skeletons, and experience an {{v:immersive}} space show that brings the universe to life.

Date: Thursday, November 6
Time: 8:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
Meeting place: School playground (Please note that the bus will depart {{v:promptly}} at 8:40 a.m.)
Cost: 12,000 won (covering both transportation and {{v:admission}})
What to bring: a packed lunch, a water bottle, a notebook, and a pencil

Important reminders:
- {{g:Since students will be walking|since + 주어 + 동사: ~이기 때문에 (이유)}} for most of the day, comfortable {{v:footwear}} is strongly recommended.
- Toys and games {{g:are not permitted|수동태 be + p.p.: 허락되지 않는다}} during the trip.
- For safety reasons, students {{g:are required to remain|be required to + 동사원형: ~해야 한다 (의무)}} with their {{v:assigned}} group at all times.

Kindly return the completed permission form {{g:no later than Friday, October 31|no later than + 날짜: 늦어도 ~까지}}. We appreciate your {{v:cooperation}}.

questions.q: What is the primary purpose of this notice?
choices: To provide trip details and request parental permission
To recommend a science book to students
To report what happened on a past field trip
To ask parents to volunteer at the museum
To explain how the universe was formed
questions.answer: To provide trip details and request parental permission
questions.explanation: 다가오는 현장 학습의 세부 정보를 안내하고, 동의서 제출(학부모 허락)을 요청하는 글이다.

questions.q: What can be inferred about the bus?
choices: It will pick students up at their homes.
It will leave the museum at 8:40 a.m.
It is not included in the cost.
It will be late because of traffic.
It will not wait for students who arrive late.
questions.answer: It will not wait for students who arrive late.
questions.explanation: 'the bus will depart promptly at 8:40 a.m.' — promptly(정각에)이므로 늦게 오는 학생을 기다리지 않을 것임을 추론할 수 있다.

questions.q: What does "covering both transportation and admission" mean?
choices: Students must pay extra for the bus.
The fee includes lunch and snacks.
The fee pays for both the bus and entry to the museum.
Admission is free, but the bus is not.
Parents must drive their children to the museum.
questions.answer: The fee pays for both the bus and entry to the museum.
questions.explanation: transportation은 교통(버스), admission은 입장(료)이다. 12,000원이 두 가지를 모두 포함한다는 뜻이다.

questions.q: Why is comfortable footwear strongly recommended?
choices: The museum floor is very slippery.
Students will run a race at the museum.
New shoes are not allowed on the bus.
Students will be walking for most of the day.
It will rain on the day of the trip.
questions.answer: Students will be walking for most of the day.
questions.explanation: 'Since students will be walking for most of the day'에서 이유를 알 수 있다.

questions.q: What does "a space show that brings the universe to life" suggest?
choices: The show is about living animals.
The show makes space feel real and vivid.
The show explains how to build robots.
The show is held outdoors at night.
The show is only for parents.
questions.answer: The show makes space feel real and vivid.
questions.explanation: bring ~ to life는 '~을 생생하게 살아 있는 것처럼 보여 주다'라는 뜻이다. immersive(몰입형)와도 연결된다.

questions.q: What does "robots in action" most likely mean?
choices: Robots that are moving and working
Pictures of robots in a book
questions.answer: Robots that are moving and working
questions.explanation: in action은 '작동 중인, 활동 중인'이라는 뜻이다.

questions.q: Which is NOT true according to the notice?
choices: The trip lasts from 8:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
Students should bring a packed lunch.
Students may bring games if they keep them in their bags.
Students must stay with their assigned group.
questions.answer: Students may bring games if they keep them in their bags.
questions.explanation: 'Toys and games are not permitted during the trip.'이므로 가방에 넣어도 게임은 가져올 수 없다.

questions.q: Which student follows ALL of the guidelines?
choices: Yerin arrives at 8:30 a.m. in sneakers with a packed lunch and stays with her group.
Daniel arrives at 8:45 a.m. with his lunch and a notebook.
Somi wears new high heels but stays with her group.
Chris brings a card game to play on the bus.
Haein leaves her group to look at the robots by herself.
questions.answer: Yerin arrives at 8:30 a.m. in sneakers with a packed lunch and stays with her group.
questions.explanation: 예린이만 시간, 신발, 준비물, 모둠 규칙을 모두 지켰다. 8시 45분 도착은 버스를 놓치고, 굽 높은 새 신발은 편한 신발이 아니며, 게임 지참·단독 행동은 금지이다.

questions.q: Which question CANNOT be answered from the notice?
choices: Why should students stay with their group?
When is the permission form due?
What time will the students arrive at the museum?
questions.answer: What time will the students arrive at the museum?
questions.explanation: 박물관 도착 시각은 나와 있지 않다. 모둠과 함께 있어야 하는 이유는 For safety reasons(안전)라고 나와 있다.

questions.q: Which is closest in meaning to 'promptly'?
questions.explanation: promptly는 '정각에, 지체 없이'라는 뜻이다.

questions.q: Which is closest in meaning to 'permitted'?
questions.explanation: permit은 '허락하다'로 allow와 뜻이 같다. are not permitted = are not allowed.

questions.q: In 'their assigned group', what does 'assigned' mean?
choices: given to them by the school
questions.answer: given to them by the school
questions.explanation: assign은 '(일·자리 등을) 정해 주다, 배정하다'라는 뜻이다. 학교가 정해 준 모둠이다.

questions.q: What does 'no later than Friday, October 31' mean?
questions.explanation: no later than은 '늦어도 ~까지'이므로 10월 31일 당일이나 그 전에 내면 된다.

questions.q: Which sentence is grammatically INCORRECT?
choices: We are pleased to inform you of the change.
Students are required remain with their group.
The bus will depart promptly at 8:40 a.m.
Since it was raining, we stayed inside.
Toys are not permitted during the trip.
questions.answer: Students are required remain with their group.
questions.explanation: be required 뒤에는 to부정사가 와야 하므로 are required to remain이 맞다.

questions.q: Which sentence uses 'since' with the same meaning as in 'Since students will be walking for most of the day'?
choices: Since the museum is far, we will take a bus.
She has been busy since Monday.
It has been two years since we met.
I haven't eaten anything since breakfast.
He has played the piano since he was six.
questions.answer: Since the museum is far, we will take a bus.
questions.explanation: 본문의 since는 '~이기 때문에(이유)'이다. 나머지 since는 모두 '~ 이후로(시간)'의 뜻이다.

questions.q: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? "Students are required ____ with their assigned group."
questions.explanation: be required to + 동사원형: ~해야 한다. 그래서 to remain이 알맞다.

questions.q: The tone of the notice is best described as ____.
questions.explanation: 필요한 정보를 차례대로 알려 주고 'Kindly', 'We appreciate your cooperation.'처럼 정중한 표현을 쓴다.

questions.q: Which best shows the order of the information in the notice?
choices: Reminders → purpose of the trip → request for the form → cost
Request for the form → schedule → purpose of the trip → reminders
Purpose of the trip → schedule and cost → reminders → request for the form
Cost → reminders → schedule → purpose of the trip
Schedule → request for the form → reminders → purpose of the trip
questions.answer: Purpose of the trip → schedule and cost → reminders → request for the form
questions.explanation: 첫 문단에서 목적·활동을 소개하고, 날짜·시간·장소·비용·준비물을 안내한 뒤, 주의사항을 말하고, 마지막에 동의서 제출을 요청한다.

items: The bus departs promptly from the school.
Families return the completed permission form.
Students observe robots in action and examine dinosaur skeletons.
Students gather at the school playground at 8:30 a.m.
The trip comes to an end at 3:00 p.m.
answer: Families return the completed permission form.
Students gather at the school playground at 8:30 a.m.
The bus departs promptly from the school.
Students observe robots in action and examine dinosaur skeletons.
The trip comes to an end at 3:00 p.m.

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 'covering both transportation and admission'이 무슨 뜻인지 쓰고, 이 비용과 별도로 학생이 직접 준비해야 하는 것을 모두 쓰시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: 12,000원에 교통(버스)비와 박물관 입장료가 모두 포함된다는 뜻이다. 학생은 도시락, 물병, 공책, 연필을 직접 준비해야 한다.
essays.rubric: ① 버스비+입장료 포함이라는 의미 ② 준비물 4가지 모두 쓰면 만점, 준비물 2~3개면 부분 점수

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 주의사항 중 이유가 함께 제시된 두 가지를 찾아, 각각의 내용과 이유를 쓰시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: ① 하루 대부분 걸어 다니기 때문에 편한 신발을 신는 것이 강력히 권장된다. ② 안전상의 이유로 학생들은 배정된 모둠과 항상 함께 있어야 한다.
essays.rubric: ① 편한 신발 – 하루 종일 걷기 때문 ② 모둠과 함께 – 안전 때문, 두 가지의 내용과 이유를 모두 쓰면 만점

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오. '모든 학생은 이름표를 착용해야 한다.' <조건> be required to를 사용할 것 / name tag(s)를 사용할 것
essays.sampleAnswer: All students are required to wear name tags.
essays.rubric: ① are required to + 동사원형(wear) ② 주어 All students와 be동사 수 일치 ③ 의미 일치

essays.q: Imagine you are a parent. Write a short reply to the teacher in 2–3 English sentences. Say that your child will join the trip and that you will return the permission form before the deadline.
essays.sampleAnswer: Thank you for the information about the field trip. My child will join the trip to the City Science Museum. I will return the signed permission form no later than Friday, October 31.
essays.rubric: ① 참가 의사 ② 마감(10월 31일) 전 동의서 제출 ③ 완전한 영어 문장 2~3개, 문법 오류 없음

essays.q: Summarize the notice in about 25 words in English. Include where the students are going, when, and what families must do.
essays.sampleAnswer: Grade 5 students will visit the City Science Museum on Thursday, November 6, and families must return the permission form by Friday, October 31.
essays.rubric: ① 장소(City Science Museum) ② 날짜(11월 6일) ③ 동의서 제출(10월 31일까지) ④ 25단어 내외의 영어 문장
